description: Delete a post by ID. Any post can be deleted except one that is publishing right now (409 PUBLISH_IN_PROGRESS; wait for it to finish). Deleting removes the post from BulkPublish only: a published post stays live on the platforms, and its stats here are removed with it. Deleting a post made by a repeat schedule also switches that schedule off. Use this when the user wants to permanently remove a post.
name: delete_post
title: Delete post
